description: This Java abstract class defines a context for data subscriptions in the Thingsboard server, managing entity data queries, subscriptions, and WebSocket message handling.

classes.name: TbAbstractDataSubCtx
classes.description: Abstract class managing data subscription context, including data fetching, subscription creation, and WebSocket message handling for entity data.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches entity data based on the current query.

methods.name: findEntityData
methods.description: Retrieves entity data from the entity service using the current query.

methods.name: isDynamic
methods.description: Checks if the current query is dynamic.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes and updates entity data, triggering doUpdate if data has changed.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Abstract method to handle data update logic.

methods.name: buildEntityDataQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to build the entity data query.

methods.name: getEntitiesData
methods.description: Returns the list of entity data.

methods.name: clearSubscriptions
methods.description: Clears all subscriptions, including entity-specific ones.

methods.name: clearEntitySubscriptions
methods.description: Clears entity-specific subscriptions.

methods.name: createLatestValuesSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates subscriptions for latest entity values based on provided keys.

methods.name: createTimeSeriesSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates time series subscriptions for entities within specified time range.

methods.name: createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates subscriptions for given entity keys.

methods.name: getEntityKeyByTypeMap
methods.description: Groups entity keys by their type.

methods.name: addSubscriptions
methods.description: Adds subscriptions for an entity based on key types.

methods.name: createAttrSub
methods.description: Creates attribute subscription for an entity.

methods.name: createTsSub
methods.description: Creates time series subscription for an entity.

methods.name: createTsSub (overloaded)
methods.description: Helper to create time series subscription with key states.

methods.name: sendWsMsg
methods.description: Abstract method to send WebSocket messages.

methods.name: buildKeyStats
methods.description: Builds key state map with timestamps for entity data.

methods.name: getCurrentAggregation
methods.description: Abstract method to get current aggregation setting.
